Commentary.Commentary: Right then! Pakistan have wrapped the Lankan innings up but mind you, the visitors have a huge lead of 316 with them. Sri Lanka's approach this morning was to counterattack and score quick runs but in the process they kept losing wickets too. Riaz and Yasir tried their best but it was Haris Sohail who in his very first over picked three wickets to bundle out the tourists. Now it's all on their batters to save the game. It won't be that easy against the wily, Herath who will be raring to go. A lot of time is left in the Test. Do Pakistan have it in them to survive? Will they be able to maintain their unbeaten streak in Tests series? Join us in a bit for their reply...

OUT! The decision stands! SRI LANKA ARE BOWLED OUT UNDER 100! Haris Sohail, take a bow! Pushes it around middle and leg, it bites off the surface. Pradeep goes back to defend but misses it completely. Is hit on the pads and the umpire rules it out. Nuwan takes the DRS! Replays roll in, Snicko shows no bat. Hawk Eye shows three reds! That's it for Sri Lanka then!
Review time! Pradeep has been adjudged LBW. He takes the review. Looks a goner here!
Skids off the surface, Pradeep blocks it out.
Lahiru Gamage is the last man in!

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Haris Sohail, where were you all this while? Comes into the attack and scalps two wickets in the over already! Floats it up on the stumps, Mendis kneels to play the slog sweep but gets a big top edge. The ball balloons high up in the air. Sarfraz calls for it and settles under it comfortably.
Quicker through the air around middle and off, defended from within the crease.
Comes forward and pushes it towards square of the wicket for a single. Pradeep is off the mark.
Nuwan Pradeep is the new man in!
Drinks are on the field!

OUT! The bowling change has done the trick for Ahmed! Sohail from over the wicket, floats it up outside off. Rangana Herath goes down to sweep but gets a top edge instead. The ball lobs up towards short fine leg where Babar Azam takes a simple catch. So, Haris strikes on the very first ball. The 35-run stand is broken! Sri Lanka lead by 315 runs!
Wahab Riaz is seen walking off the field. Haris Sohail is brought into the attack now.
Goes around the wicket, hits the deck hard. Not much bounce as Mendis safely defends it down.
Tries to keep it full on the stumps, turns out to be a full toss. Easily driven through covers by Kusal for a brace.
This was coming! Spears in a yorker at the base of middle stump. Herath tries digging it out. Gets an inside edge on the pads and rolls past the short leg fielder for a single.
Touch short on off, RH swivels a bit to pull but fails to get going with the shot.
Back of a length delivery on middle, turned towards the on side.

FOUR! Streaky! Sarfraz shakes his head! Marginally ahead of a length on off, Herath swings his bat at it. A thick outside edge flies over the fielder at gully for a boundary. More frustration for the hosts!

FOUR! Another boundary! Shah for the last ball of the over, switches the angle as he comes from over the wicket. Bowls it short and flat on the stumps, Mendis camps back and smacks it over deep mid-wicket. The ball seems to have landed flush on the rope. The umpire checks it but replays show it bounced just inside the rope.
FOUR! That's cracked away! Shortish ball around leg, turning away, Mendis backs away and packs a punch through extra cover for a boundary.
Down the leg side, Mendis sweeps it towards deep backward square leg. Abbas in the deep puts in a dive to save two for his side. Lead touches 300 now!
Goes down on one knee to sweep it but it hits the man at short leg.
Floats it up around leg, blocked off the front foot towards short leg.
From around the wicket comes Yasir. Bowls it outside leg, it turns towards off, defended towards the off side.
Back of a length delivery on off, defended towards the cover region.
Goes over the wicker and bowls it on a back of a length outside off, Herath tries fiddling with it. Luckily, for him it didn't take the outside edge of his bat.
Once again digs in a short ball, this time Herath sits under the bumper.

Bangs in a short ball on middle and leg, Herath tries to duck under it but is a tad late in doing so. The ball goes off his back and lobs towards the keeper. That would have hurt the veteran but he is showing no pain.
No ball! And again Riaz oversteps! Keeps it on a length outside off, Kusal cuts it a bit square of the wicket on the off side for one. Wahab will have to reload it.
Pitches it further up around off, RH prods forward and blocks it towards the cover region for a quick single.
Good length delivery, slanting away with the angle. Herath tries cutting at it but gets beaten.
Loopy leg break around off, pushed off the front foot towards cover.

FOUR! Picks up the length early this time! Yasir Shah drops it short on middle and off, gives ample time for Mendis to hit it. He goes deep in the crease and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary. The lead is inching closer to 300 now!
Flighted delivery outside off, pushed towards the cover region.
Flat and short on off, Mendis cuts it towards the fielder at point.
Good shot! He is playing his shots out there! Sinks down and brings out to reverse sweep. There is a man out there at backward point which means he will have to settle for a single.
Loopy ball outside off, Rangana gets down to play the sweep shot but the ball turns in and strikes him on the pads.
Short of a length delivery outside off, tucked towards the man at mid-wicket.
Gets behind the line and stabs it out towards the off side.
Outside off, on a length, left alone with ease.

In the air... safe! Riaz nicely changes the pace and bowls a fuller ball on the stumps. Kusal is completely outfoxed by it as he chips it uppishly towards mid on. Abbas, stationed there, comes forward but the ball falls well short of him.
Angles it in on middle, Mendis looks to tuck it away but misses and is hit on the thigh pad.
Shortish ball on middle, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Flighted delivery around off, swept towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! This time he opts for the reverse sweep! It has paid off again! Gets into the position early and reverse sweeps it through backward point. Abbas in the deep fails to stop that from crossing the rope.
FOUR! Good shot! Tossed up delivery outside off, Herath gets down on one knee, takes it on the full and sweeps it through backward square leg to open his account with a boundary.
Rangana Herath is the new man in!

OUT! LBW! Yasir Shah strikes this time! Perera is gone for a golden duck! The leggie drops it on middle and leg, it skids through the surface to ping Perera on the pads. Looked close to the naked eye and the umpire raises his finger to the appeal that has been made. Dilruwan walks towards his partner, thinks about the review but then decides against it. Good call from him as the Hawk Eye shows three reds!
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Dilruwan Perera walks out to bat next!

OUT! Edged and that's a stunner from Sarfraz! What a marvelous take that is. Riaz slants it away on a length outside off, the slip was taken out on the previous ball and so maybe, Dickwella tried to drive it away from the body. An outside edge is induced and Sarfraz Ahmed behind the stumps dives full length to his left to take a one-handed catch. Simply outstanding! Sri Lanka lead by 279 runs!
Slip moves out and third man in place now...

FOUR! Easily done! On a length and angling away a touch, Dickwella stays put, uses the pace on the ball and glides it down to third man for another boundary. He is already hurting Pakistan here! 4th boundary for the Lankan keeper already.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Niroshan punches it towards the cover region.
FOUR! Cracked that! Slants it away on a length outside off, Dickwella sees the width and goes hard at it. Gets it through cover-point and picks up a boundary.
Good length delivery on middle and off, from around the wicket, Dickwella stays behind the line to defend.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, nudged through square leg for a single.
Drops it short and outside off, punched off the back foot through covers for a couple of runs.

NOT OUT! Still I would say it wasn't a bad review by them! Yasir floats it up on the stumps, Dickwella gets down to play the reverse sweep but the ball lobs off something towards Masood at short leg. They all appeal but umpire Kettleborough shakes his head. Sarfraz has a word with his mates and then takes the review. Snicko shows some spikes as the ball passes the gloves but from the side angle the bat was hitting the turf at the same time. So the spike could be of that as well. TV umpire, S Ravi takes a lot of time and because he doesn't have enough evidence, he stays with the on-field call. Pakistan lose a review. Not sure why? The third umpire didn't have any conclusive evidence which in a way meant that the decision made by umpire Kettleborough was a marginal one. In such cases, to take a review away from the team doesn't look justified. After all, it's not Pakistan's fault. Also, want to add that they must be using Hot Spot in all Tests.
A shout for a catch at short leg. The umpire stays put. Pakistan think about it for a while and then opt to review it. Is it off the gloves?

Loopy ball outside off, Niroshan gets down to sweep but the ball goes off something towards leg gully. The ball falls short of the man there. Replays show there was no bat or glove involved, it lobbed off the the forearm.
Goes back and tucks it it past short leg for a single.
Loops it up around middle and off, the batsman comes forward and blocks.
Flatter on the stumps, Mendis shows the full face of the bat.
Goes too straight on this occasion, Dickwella flicks it uppishly over mid-wicket for a couple.
Riaz was seen stepping on the danger area. The umpire gives him a friendly warning. Needs to be careful here!
Beaten! Drops it on a length and it holds its line, Dickwella has a tentative poke inside the line. The ball whizzes past the outside edge.
On a good length and outside off, defended by covering the line.
Fires in a yorker on the stumps, Dickwella does well to jam it out back to Wahab.
No ball! Riaz and no balls can't stay away for long! He keeps it on a length outside off, Dickwella punches it off the back foot towards point. The umpire calls it a no ball as Riaz oversteps.
Changes the pace this time! Bowls a cutter, fuller on off, Dickwella defends it down safely.
Spears in a fuller ball on the stumps, a gentle push towards the fielder at mid off.
Kusal leans forward and blocks it out watchfully.
Good ball! Shah floats it up around off, Mendis lunges forward to defend but the ball turns away and nearly takes the outside edge of Mendis' bat.
A bit fuller around middle, just a shimmy from Niroshan as he clips it through mid-wicket for a single.

An appeal from Yasir for an LBW! But the bounce would have saved him! Tossed up delivery outside off, turning in massively. Dickwella goes back and offers no stroke to wear it on the pads. An appeal is made but the umpire shakes his head.
Tosses it up outside off, it turns down leg as Dickwella moves inside the line to let his counterpart collect it.
A loopy full toss dipping in around off, driven through covers for a quick single.
Yasir Shah to bowl from the other end!

FOUR! In the air... safely through the gap! Hurls it on a length outside off, Dickwella looks to drive. He does so uppishly but it safely goes through backward point for another boundary. Ideal start for Sri Lanka, this!
Pitches it up around off this time, Niroshan eases it towards the fielder at mid off.

FOUR! A false start from Riaz! Not what his captain would have liked! He comes from over the wicket and slips out a full toss down leg. All too easy for Dickwella who just helps it on its way down to the fine leg fence for a boundary.

It's time to get underway then. The cracks have opened up and the spinners will be licking their lips to have a go. Niroshan Dickwella joins Kusal Mendis out in the middle. The former might counterattack. Let's see what will be his approach. Here comes Wahab Riaz steaming in to complete his pending over. A slip in place for him...

Sri Lanka, on the other hand, are still ahead as they have already stretched the lead past the 250-run mark. Another 50 odd runs will surely set the tone for their bowlers. It's the hosts who are under the pump at the moment. A lot is at stake for them as they have never lost a series in their adopted home since 2010. Will we see them keeping that record intact or will Sri Lanka create history? It promises to be an enticing day of Test cricket...

Hello and a warm welcome for what could be the final day of this Test. Pakistan after getting bundled out for 262 later in the evening on day 3, came out all guns blazing and have scalped 5 Lankan wickets in a jiffy to still stay relevant. Wahab Riaz has not let his side miss Amir and it would be interesting to see if he can bowl with the same venom today. With the wicket expected to deteriorate further, batting by no means would be an easy task.
... DAY 4, SESSION 1 ...

The tourists wouldn't be too worried about the last few minutes of play, as they would believe they have the attack which would make life difficult for the opposition as well. This is where they would be thankful for their bowlers' efforts to help them get a 200-plus lead. All that they would hope for, is for their remaining batsmen to put up some runs, thereby setting a target they would be comfortable defending with. Even now, they have their noses ahead. It surely promises to be an exciting and a thrilling contest, come the penultimate day. Do join us tomorrow at 1400 local time (1000 GMT). Till then, ciao!

Wahab Riaz has been the man for Pakistan. With a spell of 3.3-0-10-3, he has broken the back of the Lankan batting. The main moment was Riaz knocking Karunaratne's poles off to end his stay. The southpaw is known to be a thorn in the oppositions' flesh when it comes to batting in the second innings or battling tough conditions out. However, he followed it with the wickets of Samarawickrama and Chandimal to pin Sri Lanka against the wall. Earlier, Abbas started it all with a peach that got rid of the opener Silva. But the hosts' most potent weapon Yasir Shah also joined the party with a dismissal.

What has just happened here? 10 wickets in the session - 5 in the visitors' second essay! All talks of Sri Lanka running away with the game could be swept under the carpet as of now, as Pakistan have come out breathing fire! Talk all that about they being a spinner short or their key pacer being absent, the fit-n-fine bowlers have the opposition on the mat right now. What an inspired turnaround this has been.

OUT! The decision stands as it is! Dinesh Chandimal departs for a duck! He walks back and takes the review along with himself. Riaz drops it on a length around off, Chandimal gets across to tuck it away but the ball skids off the surface and hits him near the knee roll. Pakistan appeal long and hard and umpire Nigel Llong raises his finger. The Lankan skipper takes the review. Replays roll in - Ultra Edge shows no spike and Hawk Eye shows three reds! The hosts have skittled the top five Lankan batsmen here. Mickey Arthur in the dressing room is all smiles! Impressive comeback from Pakistan although Sri Lanka lead by 254 runs! STUMPS, DAY 3!
Another review by Sri Lanka. This time it's their skipper, Chandimal who opts for one. Is it going down leg? Big moment in the game this could be!
Length ball, angling in, tucked behind square on the leg side by hopping a bit in the crease. One run taken.
Bangs in a short ball on middle, Mendis is quick to duck under it.
Last over of the day coming up... Can Pakistan pick one more? Here comes Riaz steaming in!
Yasir Shah is getting the ball to turn big time here! Bowls it on middle, turning away massively off the deck. Chandimal stays back to keep it out.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Chandimal defends watchfully.
Sharp! Pitches it around middle, it turns away, Chandimal goes back and somehow manages to block it out.
Loops it up outside off, defended by lunging forward.
The skipper, Dinesh Chandimal walks out next.

OUT! LBW! The decision stands! The nightwatchman fails to do his job! Yasir Shah strikes for the first time in this innings! He bowls a googly around off, Lakmal doesn't read it at all. Comes forward to defend but it turns in to strike him low on the pads. A loud appeal and the umpire after giving a thought, raises his finger. Lakmal takes the DRS! Snicko shows there is no involvement of bat and Hawk Eye shows the impact to be umpire's call and it would have gone onto hit the stumps. Sri Lanka retain the review though! But one thing is for sure, Pakistan are not going down without a fight here. Sri Lanka lead by 253 runs!
A long thought after which the umpire has adjudged Lakmal LBW. Is it batpad? Anyway, Lakmal has taken a review here.
Bowls the wrong one but it skids off the surface, Lakmal tries cutting it away but fails to do so.
Switches the angle for the last ball of the over, goes around the wicket and hurls a fuller ball outside off. KM has got nothing to do with it.
FOUR! Slapped! That should get Kusal Mendis going. Riaz goes over the wicket and bowls a short ball slanting away. Mendis gets on top of the bounce and cuts it through backward point for a boundary.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.
Leg bye! Short ball on leg, Lakmal tries to move out of the line but the ball goes off the pads and rolls down to fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Once again keeps it on middle, this time Kusal clips it through square leg for a single.
Riaz comes steaming in and angles it in on middle and leg. Mendis fails to clip it away and is hit on the pads. A stifled appeal but it was going down leg.
Drifts it on middle and leg, Lakmal looks to defend but the ball goes off the pads and dies down safely in front of short leg.
Gets behind the line and defends it watchfully.
Loopy delivery outside off, driven towards the cover fielder.
Drifting in on middle, blocked off the front foot gently.
Pushes it through the air, around off, defended by coming forward.
Drops it short on middle, pulled towards mid-wicket.
Good length delivery on off, zipping off the surface a touch, Mendis has a tentative poke at it only to get beaten.
Bangs in a short ball on middle, Mendis is quick to duck under it.
Bangs in a short ball on middle, Lakmal fends it awkwardly towards leg gully to get over.
The nightwatchman, Suranga Lakmal walks out to bat. Can he see off the day? Big task for him as Riaz has his tail up.

OUT! Gone! Sadeera Samarawickrama departs! Riaz is leading the way for them! To be honest, it wasn't a wicket-taking delivery by any means but his side won't mind it at all. Short ball, angling down leg. The debutant could have left it alone but he attempts to pull it away. But much to his dismay he gets it off the gloves and Sarfraz behind the stumps takes it by moving to his left. They appeal and the finger goes up. The Pakistan captain is all pumped up. Pakistan are showing some fight here. Sri Lanka lead by 247 runs!
Switches the angle, goes around the wicket and tries to bowl a yorker. It dips into the batsman who lunges forward and defends it towards the cover region.
Angles it slightly away from over the wicket, Samarawickrama prods forward and defends it down.
Tosses it up in the middle and lands it on middle, another forward defense by Mendis to end the over.
Full and loopy on off, a forward defensive prod offered by Mendis.
Yasir drags his length short and bowls it outside off, Mendis goes back and cuts it straight to the cover fielder.
Floated and full outside off, nicely tossed up, Mendis draws forward and blocks.
Mendis has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flighted and on middle, worked in the gap at mid-wicket for a single.
Bowls it on a length around off, Kusal is solid in his back foot defense.
Once again the line is straight and Mendis nudges it through backward square leg for a brace.
A touch short in length, sharp in pace and it's in the line of the sticks.  Mendis is on the back foot in defense.
And Wahab oversteps, his perennial issue. Angling away from the batsman, Mendis is on the front foot as he pushes it to covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Back of a length ball on off, defended off the back foot.
Kusal Mendis in next.

OUT! Deja vu for Dimuth Karunaratne. Riaz steams in and serves a shortish length ball wide outside off, Dimuth sticks back to play through the line (away from his body) but it kicks off the surface, takes the inside half of the bat and goes onto the stumps. Karunaratne got out in the exact same manner in the first innings when he missed out on his maiden double ton. He appears disappointed but Wahab is on cloud nine. This game is a great leveller. Big smile on Mickey Arthur's face. He was a worried man before the start of this over but will be relieved now. Sri Lanka lead by 242 runs!
Wahab Riaz into the attack. Hopefully, he has measured the run-up properly. A couple of slips in place...
Turning away from a length outside off, left alone by SS.
Sadeera presses forward and blocks it out gently.

In the air... safe! Yasir Shah gives it a nice loop and lands it on off. Samarawickrama goes with the turn as he lofts it over extra cover. The ball was in the air for a while but no damage done. Two runs picked up.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Floated delivery outside off, driven past covers for a single.
Tossed up delivery outside off, driven towards the cover fielder.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Karunaratne goes back and dabs it towards gully.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
Keeps it in the corridor outside off, Dimuth leaves it alone.
Shortish on off, defended with a straight bat.
Leans ahead and drives it straight to the mid off fielder.
Length delivery outside off, punched towards mid off.
Skips down the track, takes it on the full and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Goes back and blocks it out on the ground.
FOUR! Comes down the track and tries to go big on the leg side. Gets it off the inner half but well over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Floats it up outside off, turning down leg. Dimuth tries flicking it but misses.

A loud shout for an LBW! Floats it it up outside off, it spins back in sharply. Karunaratne goes back to defend but is undone by the turn and wears it on the pads. They appeal long and hard but the umpire turns it down. Replays show the impact was well outside the line and the turn would have missed the leg stump by a mile.
Flatter one on off, punched off the back foot towards sweeper cover for a single.
On a length and angling in on middle, blocked gently.
Good length delivery on middle and off, Dimuth leans forward and offers a straight bat.
Slants it away on a length outside off, Karunaratne lifts his bat and leaves it alone.
Harmless length ball outside off, DK shoulders his arms to it.
Fuller delivery outside off, Dimuth leans forward and drives it towards the mid off fielder.
Fuller in length, curling back in a bit, worked towards mid on for a single.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Pushes it quicker through the air on off, pushed towards the point fielder.
Flatter on the stumps, flicked through square leg for a single.
Leans forward and drives it through covers for a single.
Turning away from outside off, left alone.
On middle and off, pushed towards mid on.
Angles it in on middle, tucked with the angle towards fine leg for a single.
The batsman goes after this one but misses the line completely.
FOUR! Is off the mark this time! Too full, too straight on the stumps. This time Sadeera helps it down to fine leg for a boundary.

NOT OUT! The decision stands! Abbas targets the stumps, fuller on middle, Samarawickrama fails to put bat on ball. Pakistan put in an appeal but the umpire turns it down. Sarfraz takes his chance and opts to review. Replays show it is pitched in line but would have missed the leg stump by a mile. Pakistan waste a review here!
Pakistan have taken a review here against the debutant! The angle seems to be taking the ball down the leg side. Let's wait and find out...
Fuller and swinging back in on the pads, Samarawickrama tries flicking it away but misses and is hit on the pads. They appeal but the umpire turns it down. It was surely going down leg.
Sadeera Samarawickrama is the next man in! He was very impressive in his cameo in the first innings. Will we see more of it?

OUT! Abbas draws first blood! Really a good delivery, that! He spears in a fuller ball around off and it jags away pretty late. Silva plays down the wrong line as he looks to go across. The away movement takes the outside edge and Sarfraz behind the stumps accepts a dolly. Sarfraz Ahmed has now taken 100 catches in Test cricket as a designated wicketkeeper. Good start for Pakistan here. Can they sneak in a few more by the end of the day?
A loud shout for an LBW! Tossed up ball outside off, it turns back in a long way and hits Karunaratne on the pads. Yasir Shah keeps appealing but the umpire shows no interest. Maybe, going down leg.
Loopy ball outside off, Karunaratne comes down the track to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
Steps out and eases it through covers for a single.

Edged but it falls short! Yasir Shah tosses it up outside off, it turns away a bit. Silva comes forward to defend but the ball takes the outside edge. Luckily, for him it falls short of the man at gully. The key here was that, he played it with soft hands and hence the edge didn't carry.
Silva dances down the track, takes it on the full and wrists it through backward square leg for a single.
Tosses it up on the stumps, defended off the front foot.
Pakistan going with spin from the other end. Yasir Shah to have a go...
A maiden to start off! Fuller ball on off, pushed straight to the fielder at mid off.
Good length delivery on middle, Karuaratne gets behind the line to keep it out.
Once again slants it away on a length outside off, Dimuth lifts his bat to let it be.
Serves it too wide outside off, Karunaratne has got nothing to do with that one.
Length ball outside off, slapped off the back foot towards covers.
Abbas runs in and spears a full ball outside off. Karunaratne covers the stumps and shoulders arms to that.
